description: Defines data structures and classes for representing resource element patterns within a resource grid, including re_pattern and re_pattern_list, with methods for constructing, merging, and generating resource masks.

classes.name: re_pattern
classes.description: Represents a resource element pattern within a resource grid, including masks for resource blocks, resource elements, and symbols, with methods to include or exclude pattern masks.

classes.name: re_pattern_list
classes.description: Manages a list of re_pattern objects, allowing merging, comparison, and mask generation for resource element patterns.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates a mask including the resource elements described by the pattern for a specific symbol.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates a mask excluding the resource elements described by the pattern for a specific symbol.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another pattern or pattern list into the current one, combining patterns with identical parameters.

methods.name: get_inclusion_count
methods.description: Counts the number of resource elements included in the pattern over a range of symbols and resource blocks.
